mapper.sql: id, username, password, password_algorithm, student_uuid, account_type, counselor_id, real_name, status, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT c.name FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN counselor c ON c.id = u.counselor_id WHERE u.id = #{userId}

SELECT u.*, r.id AS role_id, r.role_code, r.role_name, r.status AS role_status FROM ( SELECT id, username, student_uuid, account_type, counselor_id, real_name, status, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_user ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{PageQuery.pageSize} OFFSET #{PageQuery.start} ) u LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id ORDER BY u.id DESC, r.sort_order, r.id
SELECT FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (username, password, password_algorithm, student_uuid, account_type, counselor_id, real_name, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{passwordAlgorithm}, #{studentUuid}, #{accountType}, #{counselorId}, #{realName}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET real_name = #{realName}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE student_uuid = #{studentUuid} AND account_type = 'STUDENT'

UPDATE sys_user
password = #{password}, password_algorithm = 'BCRYPT', real_name = #{realName}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1

UPDATE sys_user SET password = #{newPassword}, password_algorithm = 'BCRYPT', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND password = #{oldPassword} AND password_algorithm = 'MD5' AND status = 1
UPDATE sys_user SET status = 0, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
